Goal: A member called in to confirm which savings account we have on file for them. Find the member by their member number and tell me the account number shown for their Share Savings account.

Inputs (type the placeholder, not the example value):
- {{inputs.member_id}}: 5-digit member number (example for this run: «inputs.member_id»)

Outputs to extract:
- member_name (string): The member's full name as shown on the member record
- share_savings_account_number (string): Account number shown for the member's Share Savings account

The app rejected the member number format (not a valid 5-digit number) before searching.
Teller lacks permission to view this member (restricted account); member details cannot be read.

input.notes:
Read-only inquiry. Flow: on the Member Inquiry search form (right-hand content iframe), type the member number into the Member ID field, click Search, then read the Name cell and the Account cell of the row whose Description is "Share Savings" from the member summary accounts table.

Notes for replay:
- All interaction happens inside the nested content iframe; the left nav iframe only offers Member Inquiry / Sign Off.
- The Share Savings row was the first account row (suffix 00) in this run, but the row should be located by the "Share Savings" description rather than by position, since members may have differing account sets/orders (e.g. Share Draft Checking suffix 10 was also present).
- Account numbers are displayed masked (e.g. "«share_savings_account_number»"); that masked value is what is on screen and what gets extracted.
- The "Open Sub-Account" link on the member summary leads to the subacct_form / subacct_review / subacct_opened screens; it is NOT part of this goal and must not be clicked (it is a write/irreversible path).
- Interstitials possible during this flow: member_alert (requires a human — call request_help), system_notice (dismiss), service_unavailable (retry), session_expired / signed_out (re-auth needed).
- This run encountered no interstitials and no error screens.
